title: [T-001] Implement the public counting core
body:
## Task brief <!-- sdd-forge:task-id=T-001 -->

**Outcome:** immutable public result and `count_text` with SPEC counting/BOM semantics; independent expected values cover empty, whitespace, Unicode, CR/LF/CRLF and trailing terminators.

**Context:** Deliver the planned TextStats capability in Phase 1, Milestone 1.1. TASKS remains authoritative for scope and evidence-backed completion.

**Scope and dependencies:** `textstats/counting.py`, public facade, discoverable test package, counting/API tests and professional docstrings. Depends on: none.

**Acceptance and verification:** focused unittest checks and package-level import, including BOM-only/preserved interior BOM cases. No IO or CLI behavior belongs here.

**Sources:** [TASKS](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/TASKS.md), [PLAN](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/PLAN.md), [SPEC](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/SPEC.md), [layout](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/layout.md).

**Intended result:** The stated task outcome is delivered after its prescribed acceptance and verification; this issue is planned work.

title: [T-004] Complete baseline failure and usage handling

**Context:** Deliver the planned TextStats capability in Phase 1, Milestone 1.2. TASKS remains authoritative for scope and evidence-backed completion.

**Scope and dependencies:** file/CLI adapters, focused file and CLI tests and error docstrings. Depends on: T-003.

**Acceptance and verification:** missing/unreadable/malformed UTF-8 files, invalid invocations and channel checks. Use meaningful permission-denial evidence under privileged runners and document its limits.

title: [T-007] Support stdin through the dash input
body:
## Task brief <!-- sdd-forge:task-id=T-007 -->

**Outcome:** `-` reads strict UTF-8 stdin until EOF without closing it; both output formats/BOM modes work and read/decode failures identify stdin.

**Context:** Deliver the planned TextStats capability in Phase 2, Milestone 2.2. TASKS remains authoritative for scope and evidence-backed completion.

**Scope and dependencies:** CLI source acquisition, CLI tests and relevant docstrings. Depends on: T-006.

**Acceptance and verification:** binary subprocess input covering empty/BOM/mixed terminators/invalid bytes, locale independence, appropriate stream-lifetime/read-failure checks and named-file regressions. Counting remains owned by the core.
